audits.title: An audit addressing the quality of prescribing sodium valproate in early intervention service
audits.standard: POMH-UK (Prescribing Observatory for Mental Health) valproate QIP standards
audits.setting: Four early intervention service hubs, Birmingham Community Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: All 31 had target symptoms documented; 94% started valproate as inpatients (physical health checks unclear); 55% on off-licence preparation, of whom 93% had no documented rationale and 93% no evidence of discussion with patient; 74% had adequate community monitoring

audits.other_findings: Limited documentation of side-effect screening; semi-sodium and sodium valproate were used interchangeably despite not being bioequivalent.
audits.citation: Aziz H, Khatri K, Upadhyaya S. An audit addressing the quality of prescribing sodium valproate in early intervention service. BJPsych Open. 2021;7(Suppl 1):S64-S64.

audits.title: A quality improvement (QI) project to ensure females on valproate in a CMHT outpatient clinic, eput are registered on the valproate pregnancy prevention programme
audits.standard: MHRA guidance: valproate not used in women of childbearing potential unless a Pregnancy Prevention Programme is in place; target 50% reduction in prescriptions
audits.setting: CMHT outpatient clinic, Essex Partnership University NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: 4 of 25 female patients on valproate registered on the Pregnancy Prevention Programme; non-compliance 86%.

audits.other_findings: Only 10 of 50 GP surgeries responded; an electronic alert and yearly reminder were under discussion. Previous inpatient audit found none of 35 women on a plan.
audits.citation: Emmanuel A, Pillay P, Immadisetty V. A quality improvement (QI) project to ensure females on valproate in a CMHT outpatient clinic, eput are registered on the valproate pregnancy prevention programme. BJPsych Open. 2021;7(Suppl 1):S185-S186.

audits.title: An Audit of Risk Acknowledgment of Valproate Use in Women (General Adult Psychiatry)
audits.standard: MHRA guidance and Pregnancy Prevention Programme: Annual Risk Acknowledgement Form completed for women of childbearing potential on valproate

cycle1.result: Only one patient (3%) had an Annual Risk Acknowledgement Form completed; 97% in contact with psychiatry services

audits.intervention: Teams contacted by telephone and email and encouraged to complete the documentation

cycle2.result: ARAF completed for 21 patients; completion rose from 3% to 54%

audits.other_findings: 66% of women in the first cycle were aged 45-60.
audits.citation: Khattab E, Singh P. An Audit of Risk Acknowledgment of Valproate Use in Women (General Adult Psychiatry). BJPsych Open. 2022;8(Suppl 1):S161-S162.

audits.title: Improving Valproate Prescribing Practices in Women of Childbearing Age: An Audit Cycle in a Psychiatric Inpatient Setting in Qatar
audits.standard: MHRA and NICE guidance on valproate in women of childbearing age
audits.setting: Hamad Medical Corporation psychiatric inpatient units

cycle1.result: Teratogenicity discussion documented in 1 (3%); benefits 7 (21%); side effects 3 (9%); pregnancy test 21 (65.6%); contraception education 0.

audits.intervention: Results disseminated in the department and educational sessions for doctors and pharmacists.

cycle2.result: Teratogenicity discussion 10 (47.6%); benefits 5 (23.8%); side effects 14 (66.7%); pregnancy test 19 (90%); contraception education 8 (38.1%).

audits.other_findings: Female bed capacity expanded during the re-audit. The audit prompted national guideline development and a QI project.
audits.citation: Alater A, Masoudi Z, Hamad S, Abdulla M, Iqbal Y. Improving Valproate Prescribing Practices in Women of Childbearing Age: An Audit Cycle in a Psychiatric Inpatient Setting in Qatar. BJPsych Open. 2025;11(S1):S214-S214. doi:10.1192/bjo.2025.10542.

audits.title: Compliance with Valproate Pregnancy Prevention Programme Documentation in Women of Reproductive Age: A Clinical Audit From a Tertiary Mental Health Service in the UAE
audits.standard: NICE and MHRA Valproate Pregnancy Prevention Programme guidance: documented counselling on teratogenic risk, contraception, pregnancy prevention and informed consent
audits.setting: Behavioural Sciences Unit, Al Ain Hospital, tertiary mental health service

cycle1.result: Full documented counselling on teratogenic risks with pregnancy prevention and contraception in 12 (24.5%); partial or none in 37 (75.5%); partner involvement 5 (10.2%); alternatives discussed 8 (16.3%).

audits.other_findings: Electronic prompts, templates, multilingual leaflets and clinician awareness were recommended, with a follow-up audit.
audits.citation: Almasri A, Ahmed S, Javaid S. Compliance with Valproate Pregnancy Prevention Programme Documentation in Women of Reproductive Age: A Clinical Audit From a Tertiary Mental Health Service in the UAE. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S306-S307. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11690.

audits.title: A UK clinical audit addressing the quality of prescribing of sodium valproate for bipolar disorder in women of childbearing age.
audits.standard: National treatment guidelines and safety alerts on valproate in women of childbearing age
audits.setting: 648 clinical teams from 55 mental health Trusts (POMH-UK)

cycle1.result: Valproate prescribed for 24% of women and 43% of men aged 50 or under; documented information on risks to the unborn child and contraception for only half of such women.

audits.other_findings: Baseline audit of a quality improvement programme; mean valproate dose lower in women (1196 mg) than men (1391 mg).
audits.citation: Paton C, Cookson J, Ferrier IN, Bhatti S, Fagan E, Barnes TRE. A UK clinical audit addressing the quality of prescribing of sodium valproate for bipolar disorder in women of childbearing age. BMJ Open. 2018;8(4):e020450. doi:10.1136/bmjopen-2017-020450. PMID: 29654033.

audits.title: Brief intervention reduces prescription of sodium valproate in women of childbearing age.
audits.standard: Local and international guidelines on valproate prescribing in women of childbearing age
audits.setting: Psychiatric inpatient unit, Waikato Hospital, Hamilton

cycle1.result: Continuing hazardous prescription of valproate to women of childbearing age (figures not given).

audits.intervention: Service-wide educational intervention and application of "black box" warnings.

cycle2.result: 26 (10%) women prescribed valproate on discharge; significant improvements in pregnancy testing, documentation of contraception status and discussion of teratogenic risk.

audits.other_findings: 77% of women prescribed valproate had diagnoses other than bipolar affective disorder, its only approved psychiatric indication in New Zealand.
audits.citation: Goldspink R, Pumipi T, Menkes DB. Brief intervention reduces prescription of sodium valproate in women of childbearing age. Australas Psychiatry. 2023;31(4):524-527. doi:10.1177/10398562231169369. PMID: 37035997.

audits.title: An audit of people with epilepsy, aged 16-55 years, taking valproate in UK primary care in 2023-4.
audits.standard: Standards based on NICE, Drug Safety Unit and MHRA guidelines (annual review, Valproate Pregnancy Prevention Programme)

cycle1.result: Annual review averaged 42% for women and 31% for men over 5 years; 68% of women engaged with Valproate PPP, 21% had clear reasons not to, 11% not engaged who should have been

audits.other_findings: 50% of men and 23% of women saw no clinician about epilepsy in 2023; vitamin D given to 50% of women and 42% of men; 18 (8%) had bone density scans.
audits.citation: Minshall I, Neligan A. An audit of people with epilepsy, aged 16-55 years, taking valproate in UK primary care in 2023-4. Seizure. 2025;127:1-6. doi:10.1016/j.seizure.2025.02.008. PMID: 40022771.

audits.title: Use of Valproate in Women: An Audit of Prescriptions to 10,001 Psychiatry, Neurology, and Neurosurgery Outpatients.
audits.standard: Avoidance of valproate in reproductive-age women
audits.setting: Psychiatry, Neurology and Neurosurgery outpatients, NIMHANS, Bangalore (tertiary)
audits.other_findings: Valproate more often prescribed to women in neurology and neurosurgery than psychiatry (29.1% vs 14.4%).

audits.title: Valproate Prescribing for Female Adolescents and Management of the Associated Teratogenicity Risk, Royal Children's Hospital, Melbourne, 2022-2024: A Retrospective Audit of Medical Records Data.
audits.standard: Management of valproate teratogenicity risk: documented discussion of teratogenicity and contraception

cycle1.result: Teratogenicity discussed with 32 (13%); contraception discussed with 69 (28%) and prescribed for 50 (20%).

audits.other_findings: Teratogenicity discussed less often with neurodevelopmental disability (9% vs 20%); national dispensing rate 621 per 100 000 girls aged 13-18.
audits.citation: Davis B, Cooper MS, South M, Freeman JL, Macdonald-Laurs E. Valproate Prescribing for Female Adolescents and Management of the Associated Teratogenicity Risk, Royal Children's Hospital, Melbourne, 2022-2024: A Retrospective Audit of Medical Records Data. Med J Aust. 2026;224(1):e70126. doi:10.5694/mja2.70126. PMID: 41562644.
